title: Persistent Object Narratives for Token-Efficient Video Language Models
abstract: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) have made strong progress in open-ended video understanding. However, their visual interfaces remain token-intensive and provide limited explicit structure for linking recurring object evidence across time. We introduce SlotNarrative, a slot-based interface that organizes a video into persistent object narratives represented by compact object-state tokens. Rather than compressing frame-wise features before establishing temporal correspondence, SlotNarrative first groups visual features into object-like slots and then associates recurring observations with clip-level object entries through a lightweight, parameter-free memory that integrates multiple complementary matching cues. Each retained entry is serialized into two token types: an identity token that summarizes persistent object appearance and a set of state tokens that encode segment-level appearance, geometry, visibility, and trajectory information. This design yields an interface of only 144 allocated visual-token positions for a frozen Video-LLM, independent of the number of sampled frames. Across multiple datasets, SlotNarrative achieves a favorable trade-off between accuracy and visual-token count compared with prior compact Video-LLM interfaces. Experimental results establish persistent object narratives as a compact, structured, and temporally organized visual interface for Video-LLMs. Our code will be made publicly available.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.04866v1 全文整理；作者只承诺后续公开代码，PDF 中没有可用仓库 URL，因此当前不添加 Code 链接。
analysis.ideaZh: 先把 frame-local slots 关联为跨时间持续存在的 object entries，再将每个 object 压缩成一个 identity token 与少量 segment state tokens。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它直接研究 Video-LLM 的 structured visual interface，并把长视频压缩问题从压缩多少推进到应该以什么持久对象结构压缩；identity/state separation 也可迁移到 visual-generation process 的 memory。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 144-position 配置在 MSVD-QA、MSRVTT-QA、ActivityNet-QA 的 accuracy 为 75.6/69.8/50.3（Table 1, p. 6）；在内部 controlled ablation 中，完整方法相对 memory-only 再提高 1.4/2.7/2.4 points（Table 2, p. 6）。
analysis.caveatZh: 作者报告默认配置仍有 49% fragmented slots，velocity/frame-order readout 接近零或为负；跨论文 token/accuracy 图并未统一 backbone、frame count、judge 或 end-to-end latency，固定 144 个 LLM positions 也不代表前端编码 100 帧的成本消失。
analysis.motivationZh: 现有 compact Video-LLM interfaces 多在建立 temporal correspondence 之前压缩 frame-wise features，因而容易丢失 recurring object identity。论文希望以 object narrative 作为压缩单位，让同一实体跨消失和重现仍保有稳定入口。
analysis.methodZh: Frozen SigLIP 为 100 帧提取 features，recurrent slot encoder 每帧形成 11 个 object-like slots，并估计 geometry、local motion、trajectory 与 presence。一个固定权重、无可学习参数的 memory 综合 slot、appearance、trajectory、recent observation 与 position cues 做 greedy re-identification；最多选 16 个 entries，每个序列化为 1 个 identity token 与 8 个 segment state tokens，最终形成 144 个 allocated positions 输入 frozen Qwen2-7B。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 MSVD-QA、MSRVTT-QA 与 ActivityNet-QA 上进行 single-run evaluation，并由 GPT-3.5-Turbo 评分。作者报告移除 SlotContrast 后 ActivityNet accuracy 由 50.3 降至 45.8、fragmented-slot rate 由 49% 升至 74%（Table S3, pp. 13–14）；80/144/216 positions 的 ActivityNet accuracy 分别为 49.0/50.3/50.9（Tables S2/S4, pp. 13–14）。
analysis.insightZh: Object-centric compression 的关键顺序是 association before serialization：先决定哪些 observations 属于同一持续实体，再压缩 appearance 与 state。当前 heuristic memory 尚不可靠，但 identity token 与 state token 分离是值得保留的 interface idea。
